name: Call to Arms
summary: Following the previous Call to Arms, Drum Fel at Hammerfall declares that it is time to strike the head from the beast. He sends you after the Boulderfist lords and shaman who lair in the ruins of Stromgarde.

sections.title: The Head of the Beast
sections.body: Drum Fel says you have proven able enough to help deliver one last great blow. Those leading the attacks have made their lair in the ruins of Stromgarde, which he calls a symbol of human frailty. Hunt down the Boulderfist lords and the shaman who serve them, for they would try to drive the Horde out of these lands.

faq.q: Who sends you to fight the Boulderfist leaders?
faq.answer: Drum Fel, at the Horde outpost of Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: Where are the Boulderfist lords and shaman located?
faq.answer: Drum Fel says those leading the attacks are holed up in the ruins of Stromgarde.

faq.q: Where does this step fit into the chain?
aliases: what came before call to arms 3
faq.answer: It follows the previous Call to Arms and is the last step in the chain that begins with Tallow in Tarren Mill.

faq.q: What does Drum Fel want done to the Boulderfist leaders?
faq.answer: He wants the lords and shaman leading the attacks killed as one last great blow, because they would drive the Horde from these lands.
